content.description: Decentralized machine learning network. As a prominent player in the Blockchains space, Bittensor specializes in delivering high-quality layer 1 blockchains (l1s) infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Bittensor, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, Bittensor focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
